canonicalOwnership.typedRuntime: node/src/openapi.ts buildRoutes() constructs typed route definitions; node/src/server.ts registers and dispatches these definitions.
canonicalOwnership.openapi: generateOpenApi() in node/src/openapi.ts derives common/openapi.json from every non-raw typed route; tests/arch/openapi-drift.test.ts enforces generation parity.
canonicalOwnership.facadeMap: common/facade-route-map.json is consumed by scripts/facade.mjs; exact path wins, then longest segment prefix wins, then dispatch defaults to legacy.
canonicalOwnership.currentGenerator: scripts/build-facade-map.mjs derives family prefixes from OpenAPI path strings and source regexes over daemon/server.mjs; it preserves only path-level target keys, not HTTP method identity.
canonicalOwnership.legacyRuntime: daemon/server.mjs handleLegacy() branches implement the legacy endpoint conditions inventoried below.
canonicalOwnership.authority: Typed server route authority is verified by tests/arch/route-authority-coverage.test.ts; that test checks dispositions and that facade-to-TS mappings point at some typed route path, but does not assert every registered method/path targets the typed server.

normalization.identity: HTTP method + canonical registered route path; OpenAPI operations are generated with the same route.path string. Query strings are not part of the route identity.
normalization.facadeSelection: Facade canonicalizes the URL to a decoded pathname; the route map currently selects by path only, independent of HTTP method.
normalization.legacyPatternNote: Legacy inventory records exact raw request.url equality or startsWith conditions. Query-qualified literals are shown with their canonical path separately.
normalization.parameterNote: Parameterized typed route identity is retained verbatim from the registered route and generated OpenAPI path; matching legacy startsWith branches are conservative overlap candidates, not proof for every parameter value.

authority.note: Disposition calculation mirrors the accepted route-authority coverage test source; exact test execution is recorded separately.

rootCause.description: The generator consumes OpenAPI paths rather than method/path operations and extracts legacy patterns with source regexes. It omits raw typed routes, suppresses a typed family when a legacy collision exists, and emits a path-only map. The facade defaults unmapped paths to legacy. Existing authority coverage validates typed-route dispositions and that TS mappings point to some TS path, but does not prove each method/path registration reaches the typed surface.

assertions: 236 typed registrations including one raw GET /api/openapi.json
20 exact migration waivers and zero unclassified Authority routes
legacy exact/prefix source conditions all include an HTTP method

limitations: Legacy route inventory is source-derived from request.url exact equality and startsWith branch conditions in daemon/server.mjs; nonliteral/dynamic routing outside those forms would require an additional source review.
The existing facade map is path-only. Prefix branch overlap candidates are not a full enumeration of every possible URL/query combination.
A route registered in buildRoutes() is an implementation registration, not by itself proof that it is publicly reachable through the facade.

disposition.blocker: The route map has path-only ownership across 236 typed operations while legacy and typed stacks both retain live consumers and overlapping method/path contracts. Per-operation intended owner and compatibility behavior must be decided before a safe map/generator correction.
disposition.nextAction: Obtain route ownership/compatibility disposition for the 35 typed registrations currently sent to legacy and the eight distinct legacy-only method/path operations sent to TS; then implement the permanent route drift gate and bounded map correction.
